title and abstract.summary: The study measured species diversity and functional-trait diversity in bee communities across three different habitat types within a California agroecosystem: semi-natural habitat, organic farms, and conventional farms.

introduction.summary: The study measured the species and functional-trait diversity of bee communities across organic farms, conventional farms, and adjacent natural habitat in northern California.

methods.summary: The study measured eight life-history traits—including body size, dietary specialization, nesting location, nest construction behavior, phenology, sociality, and landscape-wide abundance—for the bee species present in the data set, which included multiple species.
